name: Brickset API v3 (OpenAPI conversion)
description: OpenAPI description of the Brickset API v3 ASMX HTTP interface. This specification models the documented HTTP GET and application/x-www-form-urlencoded POST forms exposed at /api/v3.asmx/{method}. The underlying ASMX service also publishes SOAP 1.1 and SOAP 1.2 bindings in WSDL; each operation here carries its original SOAP action in an x-soapAction vendor extension. Parameters named params or Params are JSON-encoded strings. Companion schemas under components.schemas describe the expected JSON object shapes that should be stringified and sent in those fields.
